camel_example: aliyun iacservice GET /resourceTypes --region cn-hangzhou --product ECS --terraformResourceTypes alicloud_route_table --acceptLanguage 'zh-CN' --nextToken tokenForNextPage --maxResults 100 --sort Normal --terraformProviderVersion '1.227.0' --subcategory compute --keyword vpc --supportTerraformer true --status 'Available,Deprecated' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Queries a list of resource types by filter conditions with pagination support
description_zh: 按条件筛选并获取资源类型列表，支持分页
kebab_example: aliyun iacservice list-resource-types --product ECS --terraform-provider-version 1.227.0 --subcategory compute --next-token tokenForNextPage --status Available,Deprecated --max-results 100 --keyword vpc --support-terraformer true --terraform-resource-types alicloud_route_table --sort Normal --accept-language zh-CN --api-version 2021-08-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResourceTypes

parameters.help_en: The product code. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.name: product

parameters.help_en: The Terraform provider version. If this parameter is left empty, the latest version is used by default
parameters.help_zh: TerraformProvider版本，为空时默认为最新版本
parameters.name: terraform_provider_version

parameters.help_en:
The status filter list. Valid values:
Available
Deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 筛选的状态列表，枚举：Available（可用）, Deprecated（废弃）
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 0 to 200. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页的最大数量，取值范围（0-200），默认100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The keyword for searching resource codes or names. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 搜索资源Code或名称关键词支持模糊查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The order in which resource types are returned. Valid values:
Normal (default): returned in normal order.
Top: returned in order of popularity
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型返回的顺序。可选值：
Normal（默认）：正常排序返回
Top：按热门访问排序返回
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh-CN: Chinese.
en-US: English.

Default value: zh-CN
parameters.help_zh:
根据汉语、英语返回结果。取值范围：
zh-CN：中文。
en-US：英文。

默认值：zh-CN
parameters.name: accept_language
